intent_summary: A public forecast-v1 API produces observation-only fixed scenarios with separate frozen causal history, explicit completeness, calendar validation and inspectable policy limits.

criteria.criterion: Complete zeros and signed measurements remain observations; partial tails preserve time and missing periods return unavailable without filling or compression.
criteria.notes: Inspected status validation and contiguous-tail slicing. Numeric partials and null partials retain original positions; missing tails and internal gaps are unavailable. No customer measurements enter committed fixtures.

criteria.criterion: Forecasts and fitted components use observations only, retain common horizon prefixes and apply scenario adjustment only to future learned trend changes.
criteria.notes: Current fit is frozen on complete measured observations. Tests cover linear/exponential partial tails, common horizons and unchanged history/seasonal components under scenario adjustment.

criteria.criterion: Historical expectations use a frozen prefix selection and never change when later observations change or are appended with the same settings.
criteria.notes: Inspected the fixed original prefix, explicit lag into analyze_dataset and suppressed preselection evidence. Changed-suffix and appended-prefix tests cover auto/explicit seasonality and both outlier policies. Leading-origin or settings changes are outside this promise.

criteria.criterion: Results expose original indices, fit and inference windows, outlier policy effects and separate forecast applicability from anomaly maturity without confidence claims.
criteria.notes: Reviewed unioned original screening/reference-adjustment indices, fitted versus causal components, counts, fingerprint, readiness and null unavailable series. Anonymous chronological errors disclose weak regime-change behavior; production accuracy is not established.

criteria.criterion: Validated calendar inputs honor local calendar boundaries including DST and variable months; invalid, budget and numerical failures never return a completed partial forecast.
criteria.notes: Inspected local calendar advancement, UTC hourly fold handling, strict contiguous bucket checks and failure mapping. Budget checks are cooperative, explicitly requiring an external transport deadline.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected the declared implementation and examples in this implementation session; this is a self-review, not an independent delegated review.

Before the version bump, clean Python 3.12 wheel and sdist installations outside the checkout passed both Guard and forecast smoke checks. Versioned release CI must repeat artifact checks before publication.
Anonymous evaluation replays all 26 case/policy results. Private evidence was replayed only into ignored .tmp and excluded from publication inputs.
remaining_gaps: Representative reconciled production histories and reviewed outcomes are required before changing UsageTap's Current comparison default.
The 0.6.0 release workflow must pass supported-Python and offline Linux Lambda artifact checks before publication.
